confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from the RBA page found in a search. Food and drink anchors come from one search of crowdsourced Numbeo-style data: a Numbeo figure via Expatica dated June 2026, MyLifeElsewhere, and a 2022 Westword/Expatistan report. Beer, coffee and meals are reasonably supported. Cocktail comes from a 2022 figure of about $13 for a downtown club, adjusted upward, and from the usual 2x beer ratio. Wine by the glass has no direct data and is estimated from the beer price and the bottle price of about $20. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not based on any listings or searches. Hostel supply in Denver is limited, so those prices are less certain. The 1-star figure is a basic motel.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-to-high-cost US Mountain West and West Coast cities such as Portland, Salt Lake City and Seattle, with Denver priced slightly above the US average.
